excerpt: The CMP1 admission category provides guaranteed admission to three Computer Science programs: CS Specialist (ASSPE1689), CS Major (ASMAJ1689), CS Minor (ASMIN1689). Data Science Specialist (ASSPE1687) is competitive: 'at least 20 spaces in the program will be available each year for students applying from Year 1 Computer Science (CMP1).' Guarantee requirements, to be completed 'within 12 months of beginning their studies in CMP1': 'Complete at least 4.0 full course equivalents (FCE)'; CSC110Y1 minimum 70%; CSC111H1 minimum 77% (Specialist/Major) or 70% (Minor); MAT148H1/MAT158H1 and MAT149H1/MAT159H1 (Specialist/Major only). Program request: 'Request the program on ACORN during the first program request period.' Data Science Specialist competitive note: 'Achieving the minimum grade...does not guarantee admission to the Data Science Specialist (ASSPE1687). The marks needed for entry change each year depending on available spaces and the number of applicants.' No explicit application deadline is stated, but: 'If you would like to receive a decision on your request before the beginning of the Fall term, your request must be received no later than June 15.' Students who don't meet the guarantee 'will be considered for admission using the same criteria as all other Arts & Science students, including being required to submit a supplemental application.'
